places.name: Kathmandu Durbar Square
places.ai_summary: A historic square featuring ancient palaces, courtyards, and temples, recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
places.place_tip: Hire a local guide to learn about the history.

places.name: Swayambhunath Stupa (Monkey Temple)
places.ai_summary: A sacred Buddhist site perched on a hill, offering panoramic views of Kathmandu Valley.
places.place_tip: Watch out for monkeys; they can be mischievous!

places.name: Pashupatinath Temple
places.ai_summary: A sacred Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, known for its spiritual significance and cremation rituals along the Bagmati River.
places.place_tip: Respect the sanctity of the site; photography is restricted in certain areas.

places.name: Boudhanath Stupa
places.ai_summary: One of the largest stupas in Nepal, Boudhanath Stupa is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a pilgrimage site for Buddhists.

opening_hours.notes: Participate in the circumambulation for a spiritual experience.

places.place_tip: Try to visit during the less crowded hours for a peaceful experience.

attribution.description: This is one of the oldest stupa of Nepal , Boudhanath stupa . It is situated in Boudha , Kathmandu, Nepal . This photo shows a wide and vibrant shape of lord Buddha at the top.

places.name: Thamel
places.ai_summary: Thamel is a vibrant neighborhood in Kathmandu, known for its bustling streets, shops, restaurants, and nightlife.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the side streets for unique finds.

places.place_tip: Bargain while shopping and don't miss the local eateries.

places.name: Garden of Dreams
places.ai_summary: A neo-classical garden built in the 1920s, offering a serene escape from the city's hustle and bustle.

opening_hours.notes: Enjoy a meal or coffee at the garden's restaurant.

places.place_tip: Visit the garden cafe for a relaxing break.

places.name: Patan Durbar Square
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, Patan Durbar Square is known for its stunning architecture and vibrant cultural life.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the Patan Museum for a deeper understanding of the culture.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Krishna Mandir and the Patan Museum.

places.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
places.ai_summary: A medieval city with well-preserved temples and palaces, Bhaktapur Durbar Square is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

opening_hours.notes: Try the local yogurt, 'juju dhau', a specialty of Bhaktapur.

places.place_tip: Visit the 55-Window Palace and Vatsala Temple.

places.name: Kopan Monastery
places.ai_summary: A Tibetan Buddhist monastery offering meditation courses and a peaceful environment.

opening_hours.notes: Participate in the meditation sessions for a unique experience.

places.place_tip: Respect the monastic rules and dress modestly.

places.name: Asan Bazaar
places.ai_summary: A traditional market area in Kathmandu, Asan Bazaar is known for its spices, herbs, and local products.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for fresh produce.

places.place_tip: Don't hesitate to bargain for the best prices.

places.name: Seto Machindranath Temple
places.ai_summary: A significant religious site for both Hindus and Buddhists, Seto Machindranath Temple is known for its unique architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Attend the evening prayers for a spiritual experience.

places.place_tip: Be respectful during prayer times and avoid loud conversations.

places.name: Narayanhiti Palace Museum
places.ai_summary: The former royal palace of the Shah kings, Narayanhiti Palace is now a museum showcasing the history of Nepalese royalty.
places.place_tip: Visit the museum shop for unique souvenirs.

places.name: Indra Chowk Market
places.ai_summary: A bustling market area in Kathmandu, Indra Chowk is famous for its variety of goods, including clothes, spices, and souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the side streets for hidden gems.

places.place_tip: Keep an eye on your belongings in the crowded areas.

attribution.title: Sweta bhairava krt

attribution.description: Great mask of Sweta Bhairava at Kathmandu Durbar Square, Nepal.

places.name: Basantapur Tower
places.ai_summary: A historic tower in Kathmandu, offering panoramic views of the city and the Himalayas.

opening_hours.notes: Climb the tower for a breathtaking view of the sunset.

places.place_tip: Be cautious of the steep steps while climbing the tower.

places.name: Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park
places.ai_summary: A national park located on the northern fringe of Kathmandu, popular for hiking and nature walks.

opening_hours.notes: Carry water and snacks while hiking.

places.place_tip: Visit the Nagi Gompa (monastery) located within the park.

places.name: Budhanilkantha (Sleeping Vishnu)
places.ai_summary: A famous religious site in Nepal, Budhanilkantha is known for its large sleeping statue of Lord Vishnu.

opening_hours.notes: Visit early morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Observe the rituals performed by the priests.

places.name: Panauti Heritage Village
places.ai_summary: A small town near Kathmandu, Panauti is known for its well-preserved medieval architecture and temples.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the village on foot for a complete experience.

places.place_tip: Visit the Panauti Museum for insights into the local history.

places.name: Pharping Monastery
places.ai_summary: A serene monastery located in the hills, Pharping Monastery is an important pilgrimage site for Buddhists.

opening_hours.notes: Attend the prayer ceremonies for a spiritual experience.

places.place_tip: The monastery offers stunning views of the Himalayas.

places.name: Evening Aarati at Pashupatinath
places.ai_summary: A spiritual ceremony held every evening at Pashupatinath Temple, featuring music, chanting, and rituals.

opening_hours.notes: Arrive early to secure a good viewing spot.

places.place_tip: Participate in the rituals for a deeper spiritual experience.
